fragments: and then the goat looked me in the eye like I was the one with hooves
she'd been buried twice, depending who you ask
the third moon hasn't risen in two weeks
I told her, copper or nothing, and she paid in copper
you don't whistle that song in this room
salt in the lock, salt in the bread, salt everywhere
the inkwell froze before the door did
do not, under any roof, mention the cousin
I have been in this chair longer than you have lived
half of what they tell you north of Bellridge is weather, the other half is lies
